description: Defines a reference-counted implementation class and a smart pointer template for managing reference-counted objects within the quiche namespace.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCountedImpl
classes.description: A thread-safe reference-counted class with protected destructor, exported with QUIC_EXPORT_PRIVATE.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointerImpl
classes.description: A template smart pointer managing reference-counted objects, supporting copy, move, and raw pointer assignment.

methods.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointerImpl()
methods.description: Default constructor for the smart pointer.

methods.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointerImpl(T* p)
methods.description: Constructs the smart pointer from a raw pointer, setting reference count to 1.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators for copy, move, and raw pointer assignment.

methods.name: operator bool()
methods.description: Checks if the pointer is non-null.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns the raw pointer without changing reference count.

methods.name: operator->()
methods.description: Accesses members of the pointed-to object.
